Class ClientStateListenerGui

java.lang.Object
network.client.core.ClientStateListenerGui
All Implemented Interfaces:
ClientStateListener
public class ClientStateListenerGui extends Object implements ClientStateListener
Bridges ClientStateListener callbacks (network thread) to the JavaFX UI by way of a SceneRouter. Every method jumps to the JavaFX Application Thread before touching any controller.
